description.zh: 以圆形或圆角方形小图代表用户或组织：照片、姓名首字母或图标占位。 常与姓名一起出现在导航、评论与成员列表，可附在线状态点或多人叠加。
description.en: A small round or rounded-square image representing a user or organisation: photo, initials or an icon placeholder. Appears with names in navs, comments and member lists; can carry a status dot or stack several people together.

use_when.zh: 用户身份的稳定视觉锚点（导航、评论、成员）
use_when.en: A stable identity anchor (nav, comments, members)

use_when.zh: 无图时用姓名首字母 + 品牌底色兜底
use_when.en: Fall back to initials on brand colours when no image exists

use_when.zh: 群组、多负责人场景做叠加展示
use_when.en: Stacked avatars for teams or multiple owners

avoid_when.zh: 非人格化的系统对象（改用图标）
avoid_when.en: Non-personal system objects — use an icon

avoid_when.zh: 图片本身是内容主体（用完整图片展示）
avoid_when.en: The image is the content — use a full image

avoid_when.zh: 需要展示丰富个人信息（用 profile 页或卡片）
avoid_when.en: Rich personal info needed — use a profile page or card

note.zh: 用户上传的照片，裁切填充
note.en: An uploaded photo, cropped to fill

note.zh: 无图兜底，底色由名字散列固定
note.en: No-photo fallback; colour derived from the name

note.zh: 多人重叠 + 余量计数
note.en: Overlapping members plus an overflow count

notes.zh: 图片用 object-fit: cover 裁切防变形；首字母头像底色由名字散列映射到固定色板， 保证同一个人颜色稳定；状态点 absolute 右下并加描边。尺寸阶梯常用 24/32/40/48px。 图片必须有 alt 文本，纯装饰时用 aria-hidden 或空 alt。
notes.en: Crop photos with object-fit: cover to avoid distortion; hash the name into a fixed palette so a person's initials colour stays stable; status dot absolute at bottom-right with a ring. Common size steps: 24/32/40/48px. Images need alt text; use aria-hidden or empty alt when purely decorative.

basic.zh: 创建一个头像（Avatar）组件：支持图片与首字母两种内容，三档尺寸，可附在线状态点。
basic.en: Create an Avatar component: image and initials content, three size steps, with an optional presence dot.

design.zh: 创建 Avatar 组件。要求：圆形（或圆角方形）裁切；首字母兜底用低饱和底色 + 深色文字， 颜色由名字散列固定；在线状态点右下角带描边；尺寸 24/32/40 三档； 叠加形态 -ml-2 重叠 + 描边分隔；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create an Avatar. Requirements: circular (or rounded-square) crop; initials fallback on a low-saturation surface with dark text, colour hashed from the name; presence dot at bottom-right with a ring; sizes 24/32/40; stacked form overlaps with -ml-2 and ring separation; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Avatar：img + object-cover + rounded-full； 无 src 时渲染 initials（取名字前一字/首字母），底色从调色板数组按 name.charCodeAt 散列取色； 状态点 span absolute bottom-0 right-0 + ring-2 ring-[surface]； sizes 映射到 w/h；叠加组 flex -space-x-2，最后一项显示 +N； 图片 onError 时降级为首字母。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Avatar: img with object-cover rounded-full; without src render initials (first grapheme) on a palette colour picked by name.charCodeAt hash; presence dot as an absolute span bottom-0 right-0 with ring-2 ring-[surface]; sizes map to w/h; stack with flex -space-x-2 and a final +N item; fall back to initials on img error.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现头像（Avatar）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色变量。
用途：导航用户区、评论列表与成员叠加。
要求：
- 图片 / 首字母两种内容，加载失败自动降级
- 首字母颜色按名字散列且稳定
- 尺寸档位 + 可选在线状态点 + 叠加形态
- 可访问性：有意义的 alt，装饰时 aria-hidden
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement an Avatar component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface colour variables.
Usage: nav user area, comment lists, member stacks.
Requirements:
- Image / initials content with automatic fallback on load error
- Stable name-hashed initials colours
- Size steps + optional presence dot + stacked form
- Accessibility: meaningful alt, aria-hidden when decorative
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 比较单人头像、默认头像与叠放头像组。
task.en: Compare individual, fallback and grouped avatars.

checks.zh: 图片缺失时仍能识别姓名或身份。
checks.en: Keep identity recognizable when an image is unavailable.

checks.zh: 头像组超出可见数量时，用计数说明剩余成员。
checks.en: Indicate additional group members with an overflow count.
